visual.general_description: Two-image grayscale orbital CT figure with an axial (upper) and a coronal (lower) slice.
visual.detailed_description: Two stacked grayscale cross-sectional images separated by a thin horizontal line. The upper image is an axial slice at the level of both eyeballs: two rounded globes sit in the orbits on either side of dark air-filled ethmoid and nasal cavities at the midline, with bright bone forming the orbital walls and a dark region of soft tissue and fat around the globes. The lower image is a coronal slice with both orbits seen as grey soft-tissue regions inside bright bony walls, the nasal cavity and sinus air spaces dark below them and a large grey region above. No arrows, labels, annotations, scale or text are visible.

visual.general_description: Radiotherapy planning figure with an axial dose-distribution display (upper) and a dose-volume histogram (lower).
visual.detailed_description: The upper part is an axial grayscale slice through the head at the level of the orbits and nasal region, overlaid with a radiotherapy planning display: a thick red outline running along the front, sides and back of the head, thinner coloured isodose lines in yellow, orange, green and teal outside it, and a cyan-filled region covering the orbital and posterior areas. Two small coloured outlines (purple and blue) sit over the eyeballs, a green circle with crosshair marks the midline anterior area, and a blue circle with crosshair is placed near the posterior midline. Text at the upper left reads "Trial: Trial_1" and "Pct POI, "NORM" = 20,00 Gy", followed by a colour-coded list of percentage levels printed as 105,0 %, 102,0 %, 100,0 %, 95,0 %, 90,0 %, 80,0 %, 70,0 % and 50,0 %. The lower part is a dose-volume histogram titled "Dose Volume Histogram". The x axis is labelled "Dose (Gy)" with ticks 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25; the y axis is labelled "Norm.Volume" with ticks from 0.0 to 1.0 in steps of 0.1. Four curves are drawn with gridlines: a red curve and a cyan curve stay at the top of the plot over the lower dose range and then fall steeply toward zero at the highest doses on the right side of the plot, lying close together; a blue curve and a purple curve fall in stepped stages and reach zero at far lower doses on the left side of the plot, also lying close together.
